statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and irregular heart rhythm
The patient has paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73)
CPT code 93229 (continuous mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring) was ordered
The service is ordered to detect asymptomatic arrhythmias and optimize anticoagulation management
The service is ordered to evaluate recurrent symptomatic palpitations with irregular rhythm (R00.2)
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Continuous monitoring is medically necessary to identify paroxysmal atrial fibrillation episodes that may not be captured on intermittent assessment
Continuous monitoring directly informs stroke risk and anticoagulation decisions in this high-risk patient
